traces.label: a kept strike with a clean ring-down
traces.note: The head struck once, hard enough to hear and not hard enough to rail the amplifier.

traces.label: a kept strike near the rim
traces.note: The same head struck out at r/a above 0.6, where the fundamental is weak and the higher peaks are not.

traces.label: a clipped strike
traces.note: The amplifier railed. Its peak and pp are censored lower bounds, so the site marks them and never averages them as measurements.

traces.label: a strike the operator rejected
traces.note: Saved, marked and kept in the dataset. Nothing is deleted at the bench.

placebo.note: These hunts were a test of the placebo check, not a final measurement. Same head and same day as the map campaign, fired to see whether the check behaves. The rule and the numbers below are real; the campaign that would settle 467 and 508 Hz has not been run.
